mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS above their 50th percentiles fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) during supply chain disruptions reduces manufacturing output and corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS > 140,000 thousand) consistently supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 140,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) prompts Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad-based supply contraction, reducing corporate output and profitability, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO and HOUST below their 50th percentiles fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 600,000 million) during robust aggregate demand periods supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 600,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.
